about.heading: About YSR Academy
about.intro: Ysr Academy provides high-quality education in English, IELTS preparation, and Quran learning for non-Arabic speakers through experienced teachers, organized courses, personalized support, and continuous student progress tracking.

cards.title: English Language Courses
cards.text: Structured programs designed to improve speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary, and overall English fluency.

cards.title: IELTS Preparation
cards.text: Complete IELTS preparation covering Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking with test strategies, practice, and mock exams.

cards.title: Quran for Non-Arabic Speakers
cards.text: Learn Quran reading, memorization, recitation, and basic Tajweed with qualified teachers in a clear and supportive learning environment.

cards.title: Qualified Teachers
cards.text: Experienced teachers dedicated to helping students improve their skills and achieve their educational goals.

story.title: Short Brief
paragraphs: Ysr Academy is an educational center providing English language courses, IELTS preparation, and Quran education for non-Arabic speakers.
Our programs are designed to provide a comfortable, organized, and supportive learning environment where students can improve step by step with continuous teacher guidance.
